message.content: If you’re looking for a hue that’s close to blue but not exactly the same, try something in the teal or turquoise family. Those colors share the same blue‑dominant tone while adding a touch of green or cyan, giving you a subtle variation that still feels “blue‑ish.” If you want a darker option, indigo or navy can work too.
